messages.snippet: Are you in the office tomorrow before the Indigo completion runs on Thursday? Fancy grabbing a coffe
messages.subject: Coffee tomorrow?
messages.plaintextBody:
Are you in the office tomorrow before the Indigo completion runs on Thursday? Fancy grabbing a coffee at 9 to go through the tenant authority letters? Also Priya mentioned the leaving drinks are Friday.

E
